Compound-presence head

Source: R/heads.R
dms_presence_head.Rd

Compound-anchored attention pooling (compound_attention_pool()) followed by a per-compound linear readout, producing one presence logit per catalog compound. Trained as an auxiliary pretraining task in pretrain_denoising_online() (presence_head = TRUE) against the generator's ground-truth list of compounds it rendered. Downstream, the logits form an (N, K) feature matrix whose columns ARE catalog compounds — see extract_encoder_features() with readout = "presence".

Usage

dms_presence_head(in_channels, geometry, d_attn = 32L)

Arguments

in_channels

Encoder output channels.

geometry

Output of compound_head_geometry().

d_attn

Query/key dimension.
